scripts.ios:sync: npm run pages && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('www',{recursive:true});require('fs').copyFileSync('index.html','www/index.html')" && cap sync ios
scripts.android:sync: npm run pages && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('www',{recursive:true});require('fs').copyFileSync('index.html','www/index.html')" && cap sync android
scripts.android:bundle: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
